svg.title: ElasticJob architecture with a pluggable registry center
svg.desc: ElasticJob-Lite instances coordinate through a registry center: ZooKeeper, etcd, Nacos, or in-memory for tests. The console calls the RESTful API, which reads and writes job state. Job events go to RDB tracing storage and logs go to the ELK log center.

g.text: Registry center is pluggable: ZooKeeper, etcd, Nacos, or in-memory for tests
